extracted_from: Under a Co-Investment Management Agreement dated 4 April 2025 between the Company, the Manager, GAM Investment International Management Limited and SRILIAC, as amended or supplemented from time to time, GAM International Management Limited and SRILIAC act as Co-Investment Managers of the following Fund, subject to the overall supervision of the Manager: • GAM Star Cat Bond
extraction_notes: El documento identifica a las empresas (GAM Investment International Management Limited y SRILIAC) como Co-Investment Managers del fondo, pero no proporciona los nombres de los gestores individuales, sus roles, trayectoria profesional o el año en que comenzaron a gestionar este sub-fondo.
